author: Chase Davis
title: Bobby Witt Jr. swipes another bag as Royals handle Nats
desc: Bobby Witt Jr. went 1-for-4 in Wednesday's 6-2 win over the Nationals with a walk, one RBI and one stolen base.
impact: After Wednesday's win over Washington, Witt is slashing .290 with nine home runs, 30 RBI, 38 runs scored and 28 stolen bases across 75 games. He continues to run wild as he looks to hold his league lead in stolen bases.

author: Chase Davis
title: John Rave flashes pop and speed in Royals win
desc: John Rave went 2-for-4 in a 6-2 win over the Nationals with a home run, a triple, two runs scored, one RBI and one strikeout.
impact: Rave was recently called up from the minors, but hasn't gotten much playing time. He's started only one game since being recalled and has only one other plate appearance in his team's four games.

author: Chase Davis
title: Carter Jensen's four-hit game extends hitting streak
desc: Carter Jensen went 4-for-4 in a win over the Nationals with a home run, a double, one run scored, one RBI, one walk, and one stolen base.
impact: After Wednesday's win, Jensen is batting .235 with nine home runs, 37 RBI, 31 runs scored, and one stolen base across 68 games. He's riding a nine-game hit streak where he's batted .361 with two homers, seven runs scored, nine RBI and his lone stolen base.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jazz Chisholm Jr. goes deep in win over White Sox
desc: Jazz Chisholm Jr. went 1-for-5 in a win over the White Sox with a solo home run.
impact: Chisholm Jr. continues a dynamic stretch at the plate, getting on base in 12 of his last 14 contests. The second baseman remains one of the more streaky options in the Yankees lineup for manager Aaron Boone, batting .229 with 10 home runs, 30 RBI, 37 runs scored, and 20 stolen bases across 69 games.

author: Chase Davis
title: Lane Thomas homers again in win
desc: Lane Thomas went 1-for-4 in a 6-2 win over the Nationals with a solo home run, a walk, one run scored and one RBI.
impact: After Wednesday's win, Thomas is hitting .226 with five home runs, 18 RBI, 17 runs scored and three stolen bases across 60 games. That makes three homers in his last five games, and he's started eight of his team's last 10 games. He's only picked up one total hit outside of the home runs in the last five games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Cody Bellinger goes yard, racks up three hits in win
desc: Cody Bellinger went 3-for-4 in Wednesday's 10-5 win over the White Sox with a home run, a double, one walk, two runs scored, and two RBI.
impact: Bellinger continues a solid stretch at the plate, registering hits in seven of his last nine contests. The outfielder remains one of many impactful options in a versatile Yankees lineup for manager Aaron Boone, posting an .860 OPS with 11 home runs, eight stolen bases, 49 RBI, and 45 runs scored across 71 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Everson Pereira placed on concussion IL
desc: The White Sox placed Everson Pereira on the 7-day concussion injured list.
impact: Pereira will be sidelined for at least the next week. Junior Pérez was recalled as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Orlando Arcia sent outright by Twins
desc: The Twins sent Orlando Arcia outright to Triple-A St. Paul.
impact: Arcia went unclaimed on waivers. He will remain in the Twins organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Chris Roycroft designated for assignment
desc: The Cardinals designated Chris Roycroft for assignment.
impact: Roycroft loses his spot on the Cardinals 40-man roster. He will head to waivers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tanner Banks optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Phillies optioned Tanner Banks to Triple-A Lehigh Valley.
impact: Banks will return to Triple-A. Seth Johnson was recalled as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bryse Wilson has contract selected by Phillies
desc: The Phillies selected the contract of Bryse Wilson.
impact: Wilson has been added to the Phillies 40-man roster. He'll hold a middle-relief role.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Paul Goldschmidt goes yard in win over White Sox
desc: Paul Goldschmidt went 2-for-5 in Wednesday's win over the White Sox with a three-run home run.
impact: Goldschmidt continues a productive stretch at the plate, driving in runs in seven of his last nine contests. The veteran has rewarded manager Aaron Boone with another explosive bat while seeing increased time in the Yankees lineup with Giancarlo Stanton and Aaron Judge both sidelined, carrying a .928 OPS with 11 home runs, 36 RBI, 26 runs scored, and one stolen base across 47 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Seth Johnson recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Phillies recalled Seth Johnson from Triple-A Lehigh Valley.
impact: Johnson will hold a middle-relief role in the Phillies bullpen.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Max Rajcic has contract selected by Cardinals
desc: The Cardinals selected the contract of RHP Max Rajcic from Triple-A Memphis.
impact: Rajcic will make his major league debut when he first gets into a game.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ronny Mauricio (thumb) sent on rehab assignment
desc: The Mets sent INF Ronny Mauricio on a rehab assignment to Single-A St. Lucie.
impact: Mauricio could be activated from the injured list before the end of June.
